name: Venomancer: Wilting Away chain target and Glory To Shadra! critical chance (#2933, #2938)
contract: Issues #2933 (Wilting Away 706012) and #2938 (Glory To Shadra! 706033), both classified works-natively; regression scenario. Spell.dbc: 706012 is one ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) effect, misc 17 SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS, BasePoints 0 DieSides 1 (+1), EffectSpellClassMask (64,0,0) = SpellFamilyFlags of every Wilt rank (804982, 620067..620072). Wilt effect 0 is aura 3 PERIODIC_DAMAGE with TargetA 6 (enemy) and ChainTarget 1, so Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets reads maxTargets 1, applies SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS to make it 2, and SearchChainTargets picks the closest other enemy within the jump radius (10 yards for a magic-class spell unless spell_jump_distance overrides it). Effect 1 (aura 271) has ChainTarget 0 and stays single-target. Wilt has range index 4 (30 yd), no cost besides 9% mana and no cooldown. 706033 is one ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER effect, misc 7 SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, BasePoints 9 DieSides 1 (+10), mask (0,18432,0) = SpellFamilyFlags 16384 (Venom Fang ranks 800880, 502896..502904, DoT 524724) or 2048 (Nerubian Sting ranks 800882, 502905..502911); Unit::SpellCriticalChance applies SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE. Wilt is the negative control for the critical mask. Numbers read from /srv/coa/server-data/dbc Spell.dbc. Fixtures: cluster one (a1 at 5 yd, b1 at 6 yd) is cast at before the talent, cluster two (a2 at 18 yd, b2 at 19 yd, c2 at 21.5 yd) after it; a2 is more than 10 yd from cluster one, and b2 (1 yd from a2) is closer than c2 (3.5 yd). The chain jump-radius assumption (10 yd) and creature line of sight were not checked in-game. The critical-chance comparison is against the same character before it learns the talent.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

Nerubian Sting critical chance against the dummy without the talent

Glory To Shadra! adds a flat 10 critical chance to Nerubian Sting
Glory To Shadra! reaches a higher Venom Fang rank (502896)
Glory To Shadra! does not reach Wilt
Venom Fang critical chance rose by exactly 10 points
Nerubian Sting critical chance rose by exactly 10 points
No jump-target modifier on Wilt before Wilting Away

Wilt lands on its target

Wilting Away adds one jump target to Wilt (1 -> 2 targets)

Wilting Away does not touch Venom Fang

Give a wrongly chained third application time to land
